PUID.description: Host user ID for file ownership.

PGID.description: Host group ID for file ownership.

setup-info.content: On first visit, you'll be asked to set up authentication. Create a username and password to secure your Radarr instance.

root-folder-info.content: When adding your first movie, set `/movies` as the Root Folder. Files in that directory are persistently saved on your Mac.

download-client-info.content: Go to **Settings > Download Clients** to connect Radarr to NZBGet, qBittorrent, or another download client.
